# Standings not read off the occurrence model, even up to a unit

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`standings-not-read-off-the-occurrence-model` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](standings-not-read-off-the-occurrence-model.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For k > 1, a world counted in a unit k times finer balances where it does and agrees on the occurrence model's selected relations, so no reading of them returns a positive standing in both. In still worlds relabellings keeping sign and order keep them: none gives all worlds' standings up to a unit.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For 0 < k, the world counted in a unit k times finer has k times every standing, need, take and give of the world and the same relata, activity, requirements, drawing and presence; conservation across a step is the same relation, so it balances exactly where the world does. (`Becoming.total_mul`, `Becoming.UnreadStandings.sum_eq_scaled`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_level`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_taken`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_given`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_conserves`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_balanced_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* balance; its declarations do not reach the grammar, which represents balance and cannot state it without amounts.
2. For 0 < k, nine of the ten relations the occurrence model selects, all but the same-step class, with falling and the order of standings added, agree pointwise at the finer unit, each carried by the identity correspondence; so the continuation family, beginning and ending under conservation and the class of activity read alike. (`Becoming.UnreadStandings.pos_scaled`, `Becoming.UnreadStandings.le_scaled`, `Becoming.UnreadStandings.lt_scaled`, `Becoming.World.standingOrder`, `Becoming.World.ModelRelations`, `Becoming.World.ModelRelations.Agree`, `Becoming.World.modelRelations`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_agree`, `Becoming.World.identityOnOccurrences`, `Becoming.World.carried_of_same`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_carried`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_activityClass`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_family`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_begins`, `Becoming.World.atFinerUnit_ends`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. No reading of those relations that keeps pointwise agreement returns, at an occurrence of positive standing of any world, the standing both in the world and in the world counted in a unit k times finer, for 0 < k and k ≠ 1. (`Becoming.World.standing_not_read`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.
4. In a still world every relabelling of the standings keeping sign and order keeps every such relation, squaring among them; standings 1, 2 and 1, 4 on two relata agree with no common factor; so no reading keeping agreement has, for every world, positive whole factors p and q with q times every standing equal to p times what it reads. (`Becoming.UnreadStandings.eq_relabelled`, `Becoming.UnreadStandings.lt_relabelled`, `Becoming.UnreadStandings.pos_squared`, `Becoming.UnreadStandings.le_squared`, `Becoming.mul_assoc_nat`, `Becoming.mul_turn`, `Becoming.UnreadStandings.factor_of_one`, `Becoming.World.stillAt`, `Becoming.World.standingAt_eq_stillAt`, `Becoming.World.stillAt_conserves`, `Becoming.World.stillAt_relabel_agree`, `Becoming.World.stillAt_squared_agree`, `Becoming.World.oneTwo`, `Becoming.World.oneTwo_not_scaled`, `Becoming.World.ratio_apart`, `Becoming.World.standing_not_read_up_to_unit`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar's vocabulary only.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Natural-number amounts; one common factor k for every amount of a world at every step; discrete steps; the occurrence model and its selection as Becoming.WorldRepresentation fixes them, with falling and the order of standings added; for the relabelling, still worlds only.
- A reading is any map from a world's model relations to a number at each occurrence, the same wherever two readings of the relations agree pointwise; the factors p and q may be chosen world by world.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- What conservation's equation fixes of the standings in worlds with exchange: a reading up to a unit there, or on any class without the two still worlds, is not ruled out.
- Relations that read a value or a difference of amounts, such as "standing is n", which a re-identification carries and which read the count.
- Every relation a World carries, the grammar root itself, another model of the World, or a unit that changes from step to step.
- A root in which unit occurrences and their residence are fixed by relations independent of the counts.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · The model omits relations; what it omits it neither shows nor rules out.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

That a selection of relations reading amounts only through sign, comparison in one unit and a homogeneous linear equation cannot fix the unit is the familiar fact that such measurement is at best of ratio scale; in still worlds the selection reads only order and sign, an ordinal scale, so not even the ratio is fixed.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [the-world-represented-both-ways](the-world-represented-both-ways.md). The occurrence model (World.conservationStep, Web.partialIdentity, World.withinStep), F1's worlds (World.standingAt, Witnesses.unrequired, Flow.still) and Becoming.GrammarTransport's keeping theorems («对应之像», «同族之对应», «生之对应», «亡之对应»).
- related, not a proved adapter: [amounts-by-unit-matchings](amounts-by-unit-matchings.md). Balance by selected unit matchings: what amounts have in place of a derivation; this record states what the occurrence model leaves free in them.
